input.quote: This Agreement shall become effective on the Effective Date and shall continue for a period of three (3) years unless terminated as provided in Section 5.0. This Agreement will automatically be renewed for periods of twelve (12) months unless either Party gives six (6) months written notice of its intent to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement runs for a committed three-year term (SOW Attachment 1 § 2.0 mirrors this) and Section 5.0 permits termination only "for cause" under § 5.1; IBM therefore has no convenience exit from the Agreement at all, which the playbook treats as a deviation in any term longer than 12 months. § 6.1 (p0722) lets IBM cancel Purchase Orders at any time, but that is order-level only and carries cost reimbursements, so it does not supply an Agreement-level convenience right. The six-month (Base) / twelve-month (SOW) notices operate only against automatic renewal and belong under RENEWAL, not T4C. On the Vendor side the position is already acceptable: MSL may terminate only for cause during the committed term, so the preferred element on Vendor convenience is met and we have not disturbed it (the ancillary confidentiality agreement's mutual notice right at p1497 terminates only that exchange agreement). We therefore add the shortest preferred-level clause: IBM convenience termination on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees.

ops.text: Termination for Convenience by IBM. IBM may terminate this Agreement for its convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to MSL, in which case MSL shall refund to IBM, on a pro rata basis, any fees prepaid by IBM for the period after the effective date of termination.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need an exit right: the three-year term currently allows IBM to leave only for cause or by giving six months' notice against renewal. We have added a short convenience-termination right on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, consistent with our preferred position; MSL's exit remains for cause or non-renewal only.
proposal.summary: Add IBM termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees.

mappings.element: Customer may terminate the Agreement or an Order Form for convenience.
Customer's convenience termination requires no more than 30 days' written notice.
Vendor refunds prepaid fees pro rata after Customer's convenience termination.
Vendor has no right to terminate for convenience during a committed term.
